description: This file defines commands, parameters, and payload structures related to managing contacts within the openclaw project. It includes enums for commands, data structures for search and add parameters, and contact payload definitions.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsSearchParams
classes.description: Contains parameters for searching contacts, including optional query string and limit.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsAddParams
classes.description: Contains parameters for adding a new contact, including name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: OpenClawContactPayload
classes.description: Represents a contact's details, including identifiers, name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsSearchPayload
classes.description: Payload containing a list of contacts resulting from a search.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsAddPayload
classes.description: Payload containing a single contact to be added.
